articles.title: A violent and coordinated youth uprising? That’s exactly the picture Europe’s enemies want to paint | Alberto Alemanno
articles.summary:
Each country’s protesters have distinct grievances. Listen to them, not the voices telling us Europe is ungovernable

Last Saturday night, the town hall of Limoges in west-central France was set ablaze. By Sunday, images of the fire destroying a symbol of the French republic, and other scenes of unrest across France, were everywhere, but being used to tell very different stories about what is happening in Europe.

For some, the flames announced a pan-European youth revolt, proof that a single movement was sweeping the continent. Donald Trump, who had already insisted that the French schools protests were not about schools but about migration and Islam, urged Europeans to “close the borders”. The mayor of Limoges saw the fingerprints of an alleged ultra-left insurrection.

Alberto Alemanno is the Jean Monnet professor of EU law at HEC Paris and the founder of The Good Lobby

articles.title: Ukraine war briefing: New peace proposals lack ‘substance’, says Kremlin after Witkoff-Putin meeting in Russia
articles.summary:
US envoy Witkoff presented Putin with proposals drafted by Zelenskyy and European leaders in Oslo earlier this week. What we know on day 1,702

The Kremlin has criticised new peace proposals to end the war after US envoy Steve Witkoff met with Russian leader Vladimir Putin in St Petersburg on Wednesday. Commenting on the meeting, which followed talks with Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy and European leaders in Norway, the Kremlin warned there was little “substance” in the Ukrainian and European proposals. Despite the lukewarm response from Russia, US president Donald Trump claimed it was “the closest we’ve been” to ending the war. A day before travelling to Russia, Witkoff met Zelenskyy and European leaders in Oslo in a meeting aimed at smoothing over a bitter rift between the Ukrainian president and Trump.

Commenting on the Witkoff-Putin meeting, Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov told reporters that Russia was “in principle, ready to resume” the trilateral talks in mid-November – after crucial US midterm elections – and that the Kremlin wanted them to focus on postwar security. Ushakov said Witkoff briefed Putin on “some new aspects in the approaches of the Europeans and Kyiv” from the Oslo meeting, but added that “there wasn’t really much substance in them”. Zelenskyy said Kyiv backed resuming trilateral talks as soon as possible.

Witkoff said his talks with Putin were “constructive” but that “there is still important work left to do”. Discussions would continue between the US, Ukraine and Russia at the technical level, he added.

However, the US envoy has face sharp criticism at home for describing Putin as a “humanitarian”, after the Russian leader agreed to free US citizen Stephen Hubbard from a Russian prison. US Republican senator Thom Tillis posted on X: “WTF, Steve? Look up the definition of ‘humanitarian’.” Trump brushed off Witkoff’s comments, saying “I wouldn’t say anything one way or the other”, while US vice-president JD Vance said: “I agree with Steve Witkoff saying something nice to a person who just released an American hostage.”

Putin’s order to release Hubbard as he met Witkoff appeared to be Moscow’s latest calculated move to bring Trump further into line with Putin’s position on Ukraine while offering the US president a diplomatic victory before the midterm elections, writes Pjotr Sauer. Trump had previously asked Putin to free Hubbard, a 74-year-old former teacher who had spent more than four years in Russian jails on charges of fighting as a mercenary for Ukraine. Trump said on social media: “The United States, out of respect for President Trump, was not required to give anything in return – an unprecedented situation for Russia … There was no ‘swap’ necessary for this release.”

Missiles struck Kyiv ⁠in ⁠the early hours ​of Thursday, ⁠a Reuters witness said, ⁠in ​another attack ‌on ‌Ukraine’s capital ‌after a Russian evening airstrike that injured ‌six people and damaged ​homes, a petrol station ⁠and transport equipment. Russia earlier continued to pound Ukrainian cities ahead of winter, with Kyiv officials saying Russian strikes killed at least four people, including two in the capital and an elderly couple in the eastern Kharkiv region. Russian occupation authorities in the Luhansk region said a Ukrainian drone strike on a phone company killed two people. Moscow’s mayor said on Thursday that 630 drones were launched towards the region overnight, wounding two people. Sergei Sobyanin said most of the drones had been destroyed by air defences and 163 had been approaching the capital city.

US secretary of state Marco Rubio said decisions regarding Ukraine’s access to Starlink were ⁠up to its parent company ⁠SpaceX and Elon Musk, ​not the White House, comments that suggested Musk may have restricted Kyiv’s access to the service. The Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday that Musk had ordered the slowdown of a military-grade ⁠version of Starlink that Ukraine relies on to defend itself against missile attacks from Russia. Meanwhile, Zelenskyy said the US has resumed sharing intelligence with Kyiv about Russian missile strikes after the Norway meeting with Witkoff.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí rostoucímu vnitřnímu napětí kvůli rozporům ohledně rozpočtu, migrace a energetické politiky, kterou komplikuje americko-ruská dohoda o dodávkách paliv. Současně se hromadí sociální nepokoje a protesty mladých či hnutí žlutých vest ve Francii, zatímco na vnějších hranicích EU přetrvává silný migrační tlak.
archive.security_status_en: The European Union is facing rising internal tensions over budget disputes, migration, and energy policy, further complicated by a US-Russia fuel supply deal. Russia continues to seize European assets and Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries, drawing sharp criticism from the US. Simultaneously, social unrest and youth and Yellow Vest protests are mounting in France, while strong migratory pressure persists at the EU's external borders.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na energetických trzích a další diplomatické střety mezi USA a EU kvůli obnoveným útokům na ropné rafinérie. Sociální nepokoje ve Francii a debaty o migrační politice budou nadále zatěžovat politickou stabilitu unie.
archive.forecast_en: Persistent tensions in energy markets and further diplomatic clashes between the US and the EU over renewed oil refinery strikes are expected in the coming days. Social unrest in France and debates over migration policy will continue to weigh on the union's political stability.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním a ekonomickým tlakům, podpořeným novými ruskými útoky na ukrajinskou infrastrukturu a rostoucím napětím ve vztazích s USA ohledně války na Ukrajině. Vnitřní stabilitu unie navíc zatěžují sociální nepokoje ve Francii a Albánii, rostoucí výnosy francouzských dluhopisů blížící se 5 % a sílící politický tlak na přísnější migrační politiku.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing escalating security and economic pressures, driven by new Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure and growing transatlantic friction over the war in Ukraine. Internal stability is further strained by social unrest in France and Albania, surging French bond yields approaching 5%, and intensifying political momentum for stricter migration controls.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující diplomatické třenice mezi USA a EU ohledně Ukrajiny a zvýšený tlak na řešení francouzské rozpočtové krize. Sociální napětí a bezpečnostní incidenty budou nadále zaměstnávat představitele unie.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, continued diplomatic friction between the US and EU regarding Ukraine and heightened pressure to address the French budgetary crisis are expected. Social tensions and security incidents will continue to occupy EU leaders.

archive.security_status_cs: Vztahy mezi EU a USA se vyostřují kvůli napětí kolem financování a podpory Ukrajiny a omezení přístupu k síti Starlink. Evropští představitelé na summitu v Bruselu upevnili jednotu a řeší přísnější pravidla pro nelegální migraci i nové obchodní dohody, zatímco Rusko stupňuje útoky na ukrajinskou infrastrukturu a zabíjí evropský majetek.
archive.security_status_en: EU-US relations are souring due to tensions over Ukraine funding and support, alongside restrictions on Starlink access. European leaders solidified unity at the Brussels summit, addressing tighter rules on irregular migration and new trade deals, while Russia intensifies attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and seizes European corporate assets.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické manévry ohledně pomoci Ukrajině a vyjednávání o unijním rozpočtu. Růst napětí v transatlantických vztazích bude nadále určovat ekonomickou agendu EU.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, further diplomatic maneuvers regarding aid to Ukraine and negotiations over the EU budget are expected. Rising tensions in transatlantic relations will continue to shape the EU's economic agenda.

Současně se EU potýká s vnitřními ekonomickými tlaky, dohodami o automobilových subvenčních pravidlech a rostoucími obavami z energetické a migrační krize.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating geopolitical tension due to uncertain U.S. support for Ukraine under Donald Trump and Russian efforts to enforce a non-negotiable security zone. Simultaneously, the EU is grappling with internal economic pressures, agreements on automotive subsidy rules, and mounting concerns over energy and migration.

archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, intensive EU diplomatic efforts to secure alternative financing for Ukraine and responses to U.S. technology restrictions are expected. Market attention will focus on fiscal and energy negotiations at the EU institutional level.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí roste kvůli posunům v americké politice vůči Rusku a Ukrajině, což nutí EU urychleně hledat vlastní finanční i technologická řešení včetně zajištění satelitní konektivity.
